# AI-4047 U3 pooled protocol fixtures

- `protocolVersion`: **1** (every request body carries `"protocolVersion": 1`).
- Fixture revision: **integration-u3-r1** (supersedes `delivery/u3/fixtures`).
- Generated by `bun run scripts/ai-4047-pooled-fixtures.ts <this-dir>` from
  `omnim-ai/artifact-forge` branch `wt/t_23ccc323` (uncommitted at generation).
  Each schema-backed file is parsed through its exported schema, or built by
  the exported decision, before it is written.
- Credentials in fixtures (`agx_AAA…`, `dlc_BBB…`) are shape-only, never live.
- Error bodies use the shared `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }` shape. They
  carry no task text, Room, Space or credential.

## Credentials

| Credential | Issued by | Stored | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agx_` control credential | Start authorization (`agent_gateway_pooled_start`) for the assignment. Plaintext is in the start response once (`controlCredential`). | SHA-256 hex in `agent_gateway_executor_secrets` with `assignment_id`. | Bearer for cloud routes; `x-ab-control-credential` header for tray bootstrap. A later start for the same assignment (same-journal replay) revokes it and mints a new one. It stays valid after release only for stop-fact reports of its own assignment (`currentOccupant: false`); start and bootstrap need a live assignment. It authorizes no content. |
| `dlc_` delegation credential | Bootstrap. Plaintext is in the bootstrap response only. | SHA-256 hex in `agent_gateway_delegation_credentials` with the assignment tuple. TTL 15 min. | Model-visible bearer for Room tools. Revoked in SQL when the assignment is released or superseded (trigger `agent_gateway_revoke_released_assignment`). A bootstrap retry revokes the earlier live `dlc_`; at most one stays live. |

## Cloud routes (`Authorization: Bearer agx_…`)

The server hashes the bearer; SQL compares the hash inside the same RPC as
the tuple check. A missing, malformed, revoked or wrong credential is 401.

| Route | Method | Request | 200 response | Idempotency |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/agent-gateway/pool/start` | POST | `start-request.json` | `start-permit.json` | Same `startJournalId` replays the same permit. A cloud start without a journal already authorized by the server lifecycle is `start_not_authorized` (409). |
| `/api/agent-gateway/pool/bootstrap` | POST | `bootstrap-request.json` | `bootstrap-response.json` | Same journal: a fresh `dlc_`; the earlier one is revoked. |
| `/api/agent-gateway/pool/report` | POST | `report.json`, `cancel-ack.json` | `report-response.json`; replay `report-replay-response.json` | Keyed by `reportSequence`; a replay records nothing. A stale report (superseded assignment) never releases the replacement (`currentOccupant: false`). |
| `/api/agent-gateway/pool/capability?workspaceId&executorId&executorConnectionRevision` | GET | — | `capability-challenge.json` | Stateless; the nonce is derived from the credential hash, executor and connection revision. |
| `/api/agent-gateway/pool/capability?workspaceId` | POST | `capability-proof.json` | `capability-response.json` | Same proof records the same capability revision. Proof never changes open-pool consent. |

## Tray routes (`Authorization: Bearer <OAuth access token>`, `x-ab-device-session`)

Base `/api/workspaces/:workspaceId/agent-gateway/tray`. The device session
and API token come from the authenticated session, never from the body; SQL
checks them under the device-session fence.

| Route | Method | Extra header | Request | 200 response | Idempotency |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `…/mailbox/claim` | POST | — | (existing) | Adds `pooled: [ … ]` only when non-empty: `mailbox-assignment-command.json`, `mailbox-withdrawn-tombstone.json`. | `withdrawn` is terminal for its `dispatchId`. |
| `…/pool/start` | POST | — | `start-request.json` | `start-permit-with-control-credential.json` | Same journal replays the permit with a fresh `agx_`; the earlier one is revoked. |
| `…/pool/decline` | POST | — | `decline-request.json` | `decline-response.json` | Exact tuple; a second decline is a 409 refusal. |
| `…/pool/bootstrap` | POST | `x-ab-control-credential: agx_…` | `bootstrap-request.json` | `bootstrap-response.json` | As cloud bootstrap. |

## Status codes

| Status | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | route response | Success. |
| 400 | `invalid_request` | Body or query does not parse as protocol version 1. |
| 401 | `unauthorized-response.json` | Missing, malformed or invalid `agx_` (`executor_credential_invalid`), or failed OAuth/device gate. |
| 403 | `{error:{code}}` | `device_session_invalid`, `device_session_revoked`, `device_session_replaced`, `enrollment_revoked`, `enrollment_key_mismatch`, `oauth_grant_invalid`, `offer_owner_required`, `executor_owner_not_member`. |
| 409 | `scheduler-busy-response.json` | `scheduler_busy`, `retryable: true`. Retry with backoff; nothing changed. |
| 409 | `start-owned-refusal.json`, `start-deadline-refusal.json` | Start refusals (`start_owned`, `start_deadline_passed`, `start_not_authorized`, `assignment_stale`, …) in the start-response shape. |
| 409 | `refusal-response.json` | Named refusals, for example `assignment_tuple_mismatch`, `assignment_not_live`, `assignment_not_started`, `reservation_stale`, `connection_revision_stale`, `executor_unavailable`, `generation_stale`, `delegation_not_active`, `access_revoked`, `room_closed`. Not retryable. |
| 409 | `capability-refusal-response.json` | Capability proof refused: `eligibility: own_agent_only` with `proof_invalid`, `challenge_mismatch` or `missing_capability`. |
